record: Codebase audit of the R2R, AUD and STE task specifications (static reading)
method: One analysis agent per work package read each card or story and checked every owned request, acceptance item and named test against src/ and tests/. Each COMPLETE claim was re-checked by an independent reviewer on two lenses (existence and wiring; acceptance). Tests were not executed in this pass.
scope: 96 items: the R2R and AUD task cards T002 to T075 (74 cards), STE-NXT-001 to STE-NXT-012 and STE-GAP-001 to STE-GAP-010. T001 is COMPLETED in its card front matter and was not re-audited. STE-NXT-013 was added after the audit ran and is not in this record.

verdicts.COMPLETE: Every owned request is present and wired, every acceptance item has code and a test, and the named tests cover the listed scenarios.
verdicts.PARTIAL: Some owned requests or acceptance items are present and at least one is missing or unproven.
verdicts.NOT_STARTED: None of the owned requests exists in code.
verdicts.CONFLICTS_WITH_AGENTS: The item requires a pattern AGENTS.md section 5 bans (for example MediatR, bUnit, a generic UnitOfWork).
verdicts.EXTERNAL_BLOCKED: Completion needs a live tenant, provider or production evidence.
verdicts.OWNER_DECISION: The item is an open decision the owner has not made.

downgradeReasons: REJECT. Four of the five requests hold under my own reads: the status.json archive (keys moved and value-identical to the pre-change file, no readers of the moved keys); the current-slice split (the 24 current sections equal the pre-change first 24 in order once blank lines are removed, and the 285 archived sections plus 24 make the 309 pre-change sections); the dead-reference and file:/// fixes (zero dead backticked repo paths and zero file:/// link targets outside the exempt source folder); and the backticked-path check (wired at scripts/docs/validate-markdown-documentation.py:170-179 inside the per-file loop, run unconditionally by .github/workflows/ci.yml:170, PASS). The blank-line request does not hold as claimed. The claim says no file under docs/ has a blank-line run outside docs/evidence, source and reference folders. Four Markdown files outside those folders still have runs of 3 to 7 blank lines, all inside fenced code blocks. The story status line exempts code fences, but Task 1 ("Collapse runs of blank lines to one in every Markdown file under docs/") does not, so the item is not complete as the task is written. Secondary defects: the story says the moved bytes were "checked byte for byte", but two archived sections differ from the pre-change text in link targets; the start-here agent-context index (slot 3) still says the architecture doc links a missing file, and the architecture doc now has zero mentions of mudblazor; Task 4 names 35 dead references while the status records 16 fixes (8+7+1), unreconciled. To clear: collapse the in-fence runs or amend Task 1 and the claim to state the code-fence exemption; correct the byte-for-byte wording; update slot 3; reconcile the count. Claimed tests: none exist to grep. I ran the four AGENTS.md section 3 docs gates read-only (python3 -B): all PASS, and git status stayed clean.

The state the story asks for largely holds, and the four docs gates pass when I run them read-only. But under the acceptance lens, two of the item's acceptance criteria have no code or test behind them. (1) "status.json under 100 KB and the current-slice file under 60 KB; nothing deleted (archives contain the moved bytes)" has no automated check. No validator, CI job, or test reads or asserts the sizes or compares archive content with the original; the claim itself lists "Claimed tests: None". The values are met today (34,309 B and 39,756 B), but nothing guards them. (2) The "nothing deleted" part was verified only by a one-off comparison, and it is weaker than the claim says: three current-slice sections are not byte-identical to the original. Two are intentional task-4 edits (file:/// links rewritten, one dead reference replaced) and one lost a trailing blank line, so "moved verbatim" and "checked byte for byte" are overstated. The path check (validator lines 170-179, run in CI at ci.yml:170) passes, but no test shows it rejects a dead backticked path. Smaller gaps: task 1 says "every Markdown file under docs/", yet 12 files outside code fences still have blank-line runs (all in task_breakdown/reference and task_breakdown/source), and the story's "35 dead references" is reported as 16 fixes without reconciliation.

items.summary: Server flag, command, endpoint, pure calculator and Angular form are present and tested for the required refusals and the supersede-and-approve path. The 53,421 example is covered by the same rules at other amounts.
downgradeReasons: The code for STE-NXT-004 is present and the cited locations check out, and the rule-level tests are sound. But the acceptance evidence is incomplete for two of the five acceptance criteria, so COMPLETE is not established. (1) The first criterion names PM 53,421.00 to 53,000.00 with a rationale; no test uses those figures. The command tests use a 20,000 base with the same percentage rules, which is equivalent in substance but not the criterion as written. (2) The last criterion, "Preparers and Partners do not see the form", is only partly tested. The backend asserts the flag for a Partner only, and no test covers a non-Manager preparer role (Senior, Staff or Auditor). The Partner assertion is also unguarded, so it passes if the read fails. On the UI side, the "hides" test sets the state to APPROVED while the flag is already false, so it would still pass if the flag check were removed from the template; no test shows a DRAFT draft with the flag false hiding the form. Criteria 2, 3 and 4 (over 5 percent refused with the server message, hierarchy refused, empty rationale refused) have code and discriminating tests. The Partner-approve-targets-head behaviour is covered at the command level. Not verified: the .NET and Angular suites were not run, as the claim states. The template also adds a client-side state check (plan.ts:130), which conflicts with the story constraint that Angular never decides eligibility; this is not an acceptance criterion.

items.summary: Partner readiness, digest-bound lock, stale handling, frozen case and Partner-only visibility are implemented on server and page and covered by named tests.
downgradeReasons: Acceptance criteria 2, 3 and 4 of STE-NXT-005 have code and a test behind them. Criterion 1 ("A Partner with no blockers locks the file; state becomes FROZEN before the due date") does not: its Angular success path, its digest-bound payload and its due-date clause are untested, and the only server test that proves the lock reaches FROZEN was not run. Specific gaps: (1) No spec exercises a successful lock. src/AuditSphereOps.Ui/src/app/features/audit/completion.spec.ts:227-243 only takes the 409 branch and never inspects the POST body, so the payload (completion.ts:269-270) and the post-success reload to FROZEN with frozen time (completion.ts:272-274, :144) have no test. Task 3 of the story requires exactly that reload. (2) No test asserts the lock happens before DueAt: tests/AuditSphereOps.Domain.Tests/AuditDeliverablesTests.EarlyLock.cs has zero DueAt references. (3) The server-side lock-to-FROZEN assertion (EarlyLock.cs:60-73) has not been executed. The claim's own evidence says tests were not run, and the backlog status note (docs/execution/auditsphere-execution-user-stories-ste-v21-remaining-proposed.md:112) says the end-to-end lock against the database was not executed. (4) The blockers fixture (completion.spec.ts:205) uses the text 'Final release has not been recorded.', but the server emits 'final-release-missing' (src/AuditSphereOps.Application/Records/FileFreezeService.cs:184). The 'amendment-open' blocker (FileFreezeService.cs:185) has no test anywhere in the repository. Nothing is stubbed or unwired: the endpoints are mapped (UiEndpoints.Infrastructure.cs:86), the early-lock table, DbSet and immutability trigger exist, and frozenAt is emitted.

items.summary: All nine states are derived on the server, decoded against an exact list and rendered beside the advance milestone. Named tests cover the list, render and unknown-state refusal.
downgradeReasons: STE-NXT-006 does not meet its acceptance criteria as written. Criterion 2 (unknown state fails decoding, page shows the standard decode error) is covered by code and tests. Criterion 1 (each of the nine states renders its server message) is not met for NOT_APPLICABLE: the server emits that state only when no advance milestone exists, and the page hides the preparation block in that case, so the real page never shows that message. The test for it uses a response the server cannot produce. Criterion 3 (AutomaticFeeInvoices:Enabled=false shows PENDING_AUTOMATION_DISABLED for a letter-backed agreement) has code and a Domain-level test, but the configuration key has no test, the test passes a boolean directly, and the only assertion was added on 2026-10-08 with no recorded execution (the item itself says the case was not executed). Seven of nine server derivations have no server-side test, and the Angular message strings are hand-copied fixtures that nothing ties to the server.

The docs-gates criterion is covered: the three validators pass on my run. The no-deletion criterion is not: the claim lists no tests, and no repository check asserts the deviations section, the ADR-0003 annotations or the preserved original wording. The only verification is a one-time manual reading of the commit diff, which I reproduced and which holds today. Because nothing guards it, a future edit could delete requirement text and no gate would catch it. The rest of the item checks out: the header row, the seven-line deviations section, both portal-password annotations and the ADR statuses. To clear this, add a repeatable check (for example, assert the "Approved deviations" heading, the ADR-0003 annotation strings and the original strings still exist), or have the owner restate that criterion as manual review, and then re-review. The ADR confirmation remains the story's listed dependency and is not counted here.
